transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello. Well... I suppose I'm here because I've been having some unsettling thoughts lately. Just... thinking that it might be simpler if I just didn't wake up tomorrow. 

I don't have a plan to harm myself or anything like that, I want to be clear about that. But... well, it scared me enough to make an appointment.
How long have you been having these unsettling thoughts?
I suppose... about eight months. It started around the time my brother's health and... well, his behavior changed so suddenly. That's about how long it's been.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed most of the time since these thoughts started?

I suppose... yes. It's just... well, most days I feel as if a sort of gray film has settled over everything. Even when I'm just doing simple things, like making tea, or... looking out at my garden. There's just this quiet heaviness in me. I try to reason my way out of it, but... I can't quite seem to.
Do you find yourself enjoying activities that you used to find pleasurable before these feelings started?

Not particularly, no. I... well, I still set out my watercolor things sometimes. But I'll just sit there staring at the paper for a while, and then... I just put it all away. The pleasure I used to feel in the colors and the light, it just doesn't seem to arrive anymore.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge since these thoughts started?
I don't believe so, no. I haven't really noticed feeling... on edge, or anything of that sort. It's mostly just... what I've already described.
Do you feel much interest in activities or hobbies you used to enjoy before these feelings started?
No, not really. It's... much like what I just said about the painting. I just don't feel particularly drawn to do much of anything right now.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight since these feelings started?
I don't believe so. I haven't really been keeping track of it, but... my clothes seem to fit about the same. So, no.
Have you noticed any change in how actively you move or how quickly you do things since these feelings started?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I suppose I just go about things at my normal pace... there hasn't really been a change that I'm aware of.
Have you experienced periods of significant depression like this before in your life?
No... I don't believe so. I haven't really felt quite like this before.
Do you feel any pleasure when you're doing things that normally would bring you happiness?

Not really, no. I... well, I still set out my watercolor things sometimes. But I'll just sit there, staring at the paper, and then I end up putting it all away. The pleasure I used to feel in the color and light... it just doesn't seem to arrive.
Have you had any periods in your life where you felt significantly depressed before the episode that started about eight months ago?
No... I believe I just mentioned this, but no. I haven't experienced anything like this before.
Would you say these feelings of sadness and heaviness have been consistently present every day since they started, or have they varied in intensity over time?

Well... most days, yes. It's just... always there. It feels as though a sort of gray film has settled over everything. Even when I'm just making a cup of tea, or looking out at the garden... there's this quiet heaviness in me. I try to reason my way out of it, but... I just can't quite seem to.
Do you feel any pleasure at all when you're doing things?
I... well, I thought we just spoke about this. With the watercolors. It's... no, not really.
Have these feelings of sadness and heaviness interfered with your ability to work or take care of things at home?

I... well, I suppose I still manage the essentials around the house. But... I've stopped going to my walking group. And the mentoring I used to do... I've stepped back from that, too. I just... I can't seem to follow through with it anymore, or really be present with people. So, I just... stay home, mostly.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or enjoy doing?
I... I don't believe so. As I just mentioned... no. Nothing really comes to mind right now.
Can you think of any activities that you still look forward to?
No... I don't think so. It's really just the same as what I just said. There isn't anything.
Would you say these feelings of sadness and heaviness have been present every day since they started, without any periods where you felt significantly better?
I... I haven't really kept track of it that closely. It all just sort of... blends together, I suppose. I'm not really sure if there are better days or not.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt completely free of these sad and heavy feelings?

Completely free? I... no, I wouldn't say that. Most days... it just feels as if a gray film has settled over everything. Even when I'm just making tea, or looking out at my garden... there's still this quiet heaviness. I try to reason my way out of it, but... I just can't quite seem to.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or making decisions since these feelings started?
I... no, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed any trouble with that... as far as I know.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy, but now find you no longer take pleasure in?

I suppose... yes. I still set out my watercolor things sometimes. But I'll just sit there, looking at the blank paper, and then... I just put it all away again. The pleasure I used to feel in the colors and the light... it just doesn't seem to arrive anymore.
